label: nyiso 77 ordc span
definition: (PROBE — not promoted) nyiso-76 COMBINED arm (ORDC-span + oil-daily): the (inert) ORDC measured-step-span fix plus the daily-resolution dual-fuel oil-parity cap. Identical to the oil-daily-alone arm (2026-07-26-nyiso-78-oil-daily) to 4 decimal places, since the ORDC-span fix contributes nothing on this config; the combination's entire effect is the oil cap's. See docs/FINDING-nyiso-ordc-span-reliability-floor-2026-07-26.md sections 1-2.
